newsitem.title: UK: Ultra Electronics shares strike firm market debut.
newsitem.headline: Ultra Electronics shares strike firm market debut.

text.p: Shares in defence and aerospace equipment manufacturer Ultra Electronics began trading at a fourteen percent premium to their placing price of 250p on the London Stock Exchange on Thursday.
The shares opened 34p above the 250p placing price and by 1118 GMT had risen to 285.5p in bouyant trade of over 12 million shares.
"The placing went extremely well," chairman Peter Macfarlane told Reuters, adding that large pension funds were among buyers of the shares.
The company raised 85.9 million stg in an institutional placing, giving it a market capitalisation of 162.5 million stg.
"We are aiming to grow organically and are keeping an eye out for acquisition opportunities," Macfarlane said.
Broker to the placing was Cazenove and Schroders acted as sponsor and underwriter to the issue.
